title: loveai-persona-data
subtitle: SFT + DPO pairs for the loveAI companion voice (1B QLoRA)
description:
# loveAI Persona Training Data

SFT + DPO data for the loveAI companion persona model (1B QLoRA: `ml/train.py` -> `ml/train_dpo.py` -> `ml/merge.py` -> `ml/serve.py`).

Generated deterministically by `ml/datasets/build_dataset.py` from the loveAI 17-trait psychology matrix (`shared/persona-matrix.json`) plus the real-dataset adapters in `ml/datasets/real_sources.py`.

## Files

| File | Rows | Use |
|---|---|---|
| `persona_sft_train.jsonl` | 4680 | SFT: system persona + user prompt + assistant reply |
| `persona_sft_val.jsonl` | 520 | SFT validation |
| `persona_dpo_train.jsonl` | 4680 | DPO: prompt + chosen (persona-aligned) + rejected (mismatched) |
| `persona_dpo_val.jsonl` | 520 | DPO validation |
| `persona_prompts.jsonl` | 200 | The sampled persona profiles (`{persona_id, scores, persona_text}`) - reuse these when merging external dialogue so the system prompt stays byte-identical to training |
| `persona-matrix.json` | - | 17-dim / 34-item trait matrix (source of the persona text) |
| `dataset_report.json` | - | Build report: seed, counts per source, quality gate, license registry for every candidate dataset |

Row counts are for the shipped build (`--n 200 --seed 42`); `dataset_report.json` is the authoritative record.

## Schema

- SFT: `{"persona_id": int, "messages": [{"role": "system", "content": "<persona text>"}, {"role": "user", ...}, {"role": "assistant", ...}]}`
  - Multi-turn rows exist (system + up to 5 context messages + assistant target) so the model learns conversation memory, not just single replies.
- DPO: `{"persona_id": int, "prompt": [system, user], "chosen": [assistant], "rejected": [assistant]}`

Both schemas are exactly what `ml/train.py` (ChatML via the model's own chat template) and `ml/train_dpo.py` consume - train format == serve format.

## Themes covered (26 prompts, 26 scenarios)

Core: stress/drain, procrastination, career change, presentation nerves, conflict with a friend, good news, overthinking, low mood, directionlessness, criticism, celebration, loneliness.

Added: grief, breakup, partner conflict, family pressure, self-worth/comparison, money stress, sleep, social anxiety, dating fatigue, boundaries/overcommitment, everyday check-in/small talk, health worry, anger, big life decisions.

## Strengthening it with real conversations

The bundle is intentionally synthetic-only (licensing-clean). Real conversational data is added at build time instead:

```bash
python ml/datasets/build_dataset.py --real-data            # permissive-license sources only
python ml/datasets/build_dataset.py --real-data all        # + CC-BY-NC / unclear-license sources (research)
python ml/datasets/build_dataset.py --list-real-sources    # registry: ids, licenses, sizes, what each maps to
```

Source registry (ranked by fit for an empathetic, persona-based companion; see `dataset_report.json` for the machine-readable copy):

| # | Dataset | License | ~Dialogs | What it adds |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | [EmpatheticDialogues](https://huggingface.co/datasets/Estwld/empathetic_dialogues_llm) (parquet mirror; original [facebook/empathetic_dialogues](https://huggingface.co/datasets/facebook/empathetic_dialogues)) | CC-BY-NC-4.0 | 24,850 | The standard empathy benchmark: 32 emotion labels, situation-grounded, peer register |
| 2 | [ESConv](https://huggingface.co/datasets/thu-coai/esconv) | CC-BY-NC-4.0 | 1,300 | Human emotional-support conversations with helping-skills strategy labels |
| 3 | [counsel-chat](https://huggingface.co/datasets/nbertagnolli/counsel-chat) | unclear (Kaggle copy: CC0) | 2,775 | Licensed-therapist answers on relationships, anxiety, self-esteem |
| 4 | [Synthetic-Persona-Chat](https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/Synthetic-Persona-Chat) | CC-BY-4.0 | 10,906 | Persona-conditioned everyday chat - fills the small-talk gap |
| 5 | [SODA](https://huggingface.co/datasets/allenai/soda) | CC-BY-4.0 | 1,489,842 | 1.5M short social dialogues: light, ordinary, non-crisis conversation |
| 6 | [mental_health_therapy](https://huggingface.co/datasets/fadodr/mental_health_therapy) | MIT | 12,258 | Long-form therapist-style answers (likely GPT-generated) |
| 7 | [Relationship_Advice](https://huggingface.co/datasets/yonatanko/Relationship_Advice) | unknown (Reddit) | 400 | The only **human preference** labels here -> real DPO chosen/rejected pairs |
| 8 | [therapy-conversations-multiturn](https://huggingface.co/datasets/Abc7347/therapy-conversations-multiturn) | not stated | 2,020 | Multi-turn therapy sessions in chat format |

Also considered: `Amod/mental_health_counseling_conversations` (gated, RAIL-D - restricts commercial use, not usable without auth), `bavard/personachat_truecased` and `li2017dailydialog/daily_dialog` (persona/daily chat but no explicit permissive license), MBTI datasets (`aayus017/mbti-personality-dataset`, `pandalla/Machine_Mindset_MBTI_dataset` - personality labels on posts, not dialogues; useful for persona *conditioning* research, not for this SFT corpus).

### Quality gate (applied to every real row)

- Dialogue level: starts with a user turn, no crisis/self-harm content anywhere, >= 12 words.
- Row level: assistant target >= 4 words, user turns >= 2 words, no turn > 220 words, no row > 700 words, no clinical/deflection register (`as an AI`, `seek professional help`, `medication`, `diagnos*`, ...) in the assistant text.
- Crisis content is filtered out entirely by design: loveAI is a companion, not a crisis service - that content belongs in a hand-authored safety set, not in scraped SFT data.

## Regenerate

```bash
python ml/datasets/build_dataset.py --n 200 --seed 42 --out-dir kaggle/loveai-persona-data
```

Deterministic: same seed + same source versions -> same data.
